change: An explicit ArmMeasurement may replace only a read-only status request. Both transport/model policy and measurement control availability agree; arming still requires current valid source and ownership. No keying, delayed queue or automatic rearm is introduced.

failures: FAIL: explicit measurement arm must replace read-only status
FAIL: uncorrected measurement source did not replace a read-only poll
FAIL: read-only status poll must not disable explicit measurement arm

covered: status query abort on explicit configured and legacy measurement arm
measurement button remains enabled through a fresh read-only poll
duplicate arm does not preempt an arm
late status does not override arm
old or foreign session and invalid IQ/tone/keyed gates in existing complete tests

limitations: Component qualification; new desktop must be relaunched and the ordinary receive-only arm/cancel path checked before RF.

Retained evidence shows a live disabled-before-dispatch Arm refusal and a separate deferred Arm with no observed arm. The exact deferred callback interleaving is not recorded; the socket-free test proves the status-poll blocking defect and the fix.
A corrected finite5W cold-start capture is independently verified, but the matching new baseline remains incomplete.
